# Documentation Standards

## Writing Rules
- Use concise, directive language.
- Separate required actions from guidance.
- Include prohibited actions where applicable.

## Structure Rules
- Include purpose and when-to-use sections.
- Include explicit stop conditions for gated workflows.
- Cross-link related governance artifacts.

## Discoverability Rules
- Keep `.github/README.md` updated when adding governance categories.
- Use stable file naming aligned with category intent.
